rubric.role_summary: Senior automotive reconditioning technician responsible for inspecting, diagnosing, and repairing used electric vehicles, establishing reconditioning procedures, coordinating vendors, and eventually guiding junior technicians.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior automotive reconditioning technician responsible for inspecting, diagnosing, and repairing used electric vehicles, establishing reconditioning procedures, coordinating vendors, and eventually guiding junior technicians.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of automotive technician experience, including hands-on diagnostic work.
- Experience using OEM or aftermarket diagnostic software and scan tools.
- Ability to read wiring diagrams, service manuals, and technical knowledgebases.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Previous EV OEM experience, such as Tesla, Rivian, or Lucid.
- Powertrain experience involving HV batteries or drive units.
- ASE A-series A4–A8 certifications plus L1 and/or L3 advanced certification and L4 ADAS certification.
- Experience independently owning a broad scope spanning hands-on diagnostics, inspections, repairs, on-site operations, and SOP development.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Los Angeles area, California. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
